publisher: Hawaii State GIS (HawaiiStateGIS) - City & County of Honolulu tax parcels
notes: Tax parcel boundaries for City & County of Honolulu (Oahu), current to April 2026. TMK is the tax map key. Filter drops a few very large non-taxlot polygons (e.g. state/forest land) whose centroids fall far from their tax-lot location. No owner or assessed value fields in this layer. zone is the zone/section code, not land use.
